title: Every kbmon surface prints the same needs you line and session lines
goal: the needs you line and the session lines come from mon_needs and mon_sessions alone, so --once, the live view, kbmon --status, the kb_monitor_status tool and the kbmon pane (which runs --once) print the same text; the receipt's line ends with the needs you count and the command that prints it, and its fingerprint still moves only with the alerts

run:
import json,os,re,subprocess as s,sys,tempfile
k=lambda *a:s.run([sys.executable,'_tools/kbmon.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=180,env=dict(os.environ,COLUMNS='400'))
snap=json.loads(k('--json').stdout);P=snap['panels']
for n in ('sprint','querylog','sessions','host'):P[n]={'state':'ok','seconds':0.1,'data':P[n].get('data') or {}}
sp=P['sprint']['data'];sp['sprints']=[{'id':'SP-aaaaaaaa','state':'active','title':'A plant sprint','items':{'todo':2},'next':'ST-bbbbbbbb','next_title':'Plant item',
    'open':[{'id':'ST-bbbbbbbb','title':'Plant item','status':'todo'}],'done_at':[],'waiting':[{'item':'ST-bbbbbbbb','gate':'g-plant'}]}]
P['querylog']['data']['last_delivery']={'outcome':'refused','why':'gate lint failed','when':'2026-10-19T08:00:00Z'}
P['sessions']['data']['sessions']=[{'label':'s-1a2b3c','role':'worker','item':'ST-bbbbbbbb','item_title':'Plant item','sprint':'SP-aaaaaaaa','sprint_title':'A plant sprint',
    'step':'work','started':'2026-10-19T07:00:00Z','last_activity':'2026-10-19T07:40:00Z','spend_usd':0.5}]
d=tempfile.mkdtemp();f=os.path.join(d,'a.json');json.dump(snap,open(f,'w'))
sp['sprints'][0]['waiting'][0]['gate']='g-other';g=os.path.join(d,'b.json');json.dump(snap,open(g,'w'))
once=k('--once','--from-snapshot',f).stdout;st=k('--status','all','--from-snapshot',f).stdout.splitlines();ses=k('--status','sessions','--from-snapshot',f).stdout
ra=json.loads(k('--receipt','--from-snapshot',f).stdout);rb=json.loads(k('--receipt','--from-snapshot',g).stdout)
sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import kb_mcp
mcp=kb_mcp.kb_monitor_status({'topic':'all'}).splitlines();live=k('--status','all').stdout.splitlines()
nl=[l for l in once.splitlines() if l.lower().startswith('needs you')]
srow=[l.strip() for l in ses.splitlines() if re.search(r'\bs-[0-9a-f]{6}\b',l)]
print(nl[:1],st[:1],ra['line'],mcp[:1],live[:1],srow)
ok=(len(nl)==1 and st[:1]==nl and 'needs you' in ra['line'].lower() and ra['fingerprint']==rb['fingerprint']
    and mcp[:1]==live[:1] and mcp[0].lower().startswith('needs you') and len(srow)==1 and srow[0] in once)
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

notes: Operator request 2026-10-19: make kbmon readable and useful for a human operator (summaries of what sessions do); the orchestrator's notes from watching the night run of 2026-10-19 with kbmon. Premise on origin/main 9cee34c, 2026-10-19: with a planted waiting gate, a refused delivery and a sessions entry, --once has no needs you line, --status all and kb_monitor_status start with the sessions line, the receipt names only the alerts and no line carries the session label.
